subject: MAP kickoff: proposed role split, milestones, and risk gates
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily@borealishealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: proposed role split, milestones, and risk gates

Emily — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and a first-pass MAP outline for your review. I attached a working spreadsheet (redwood_map_v1.xlsx) and a slide that visualizes milestones. Please confirm stakeholders and preferred timeline option (A/B/C) below so we can lock owners in the doc.

Call highlights (short):
- Primary use case: prioritized internal triage for post-discharge care (high throughput embeddings + inference).
- Data flow: Borealis will route anonymized discharge summaries via SFTP to your VPC deployment.
- Security posture: SOC2 + customer-managed KMS required; procurement will request evidence.
- Timeline sensitivity: pilot requested to start in Q3; procurement wants clear milestones and acceptance criteria.

Proposed MAP (initial draft):
1) Milestone 0 — Contract & Security paperwork
   - Owner: Borealis procurement / Redwood legal (Aditya)
   - Target: 2027-05-31
   - Dependencies: customer SOC2 checklist items, KMS integration plan
2) Milestone 1 — Private deployment (VPC) provisioning + connectivity test
   - Owner: Redwood infra (Logan) / Borealis infra (TBD)
   - Target: 2027-06-15
   - Dependencies: firewall rules, IP allowlist, SFTP endpoint
3) Milestone 2 — Pilot dataset ingest + inference runbook validation
   - Owner: Borealis data ops / Redwood integration (Marissa)
   - Target: 2027-07-07
   - Acceptance: latency < 300ms p95 for 512-token requests, successful end-to-end pass on 3 sample batches
4) Milestone 3 — Pilot evaluation & quality sign-off
   - Owner: Borealis clinical ops / Redwood CS (Marissa)
   - Target: 2027-07-21
   - Dependencies: annotated eval set, evaluation rubric (attached)
5) Milestone 4 — Production cutover & monitoring handoff
   - Owner: Borealis platform / Redwood SRE (Logan)

From: Emily Zhang <emily@borealishealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Borealis Health Procurement <procurement@borealishealth.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: proposed role split, milestones, and risk gates

Thanks, Logan — this is helpful and much appreciated. A few quick notes from our side:
- Procurement will own Milestone 0 but requests a hard copy of the SOC2 evidence and an initial cost estimate line itemized by pilot vs production. I looped procurement above.
- For Milestone 1, our infra contact is Ravi Shah (ravi.shah@borealishealth.com). Please add him to the MAP and copy him on provisioning emails.
- For Milestone 2 acceptance criteria, can we add a quality gate: F1-score >= 0.72 on the labeled validation subset? Clinical team needs a quantitative threshold.

Timeline preference: Option B (pilot kickoff mid-June) keeps internal stakeholders happy, but procurement may push Contract completion to end-May depending on their review.

I'll review the spreadsheet tonight and put inline comments. If you can add Ravi to the doc and update the acceptance gate, we'll circulate to internal stakeholders tomorrow.

—Emily
Clinical Programs Lead, Borealis Health

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily@borealishealth.com>, Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@borealishealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: proposed role split, milestones, and risk gates

Emily / Ravi — added Ravi to the MAP (sheet "Owners") and updated Milestone 2 to include the F1 >= 0.72 quality gate. I also uploaded a slightly revised spreadsheet (redwood_map_v1.xlsx -> redwood_map_v1.1.xlsx) to the Drive link. Links below.

Three timeline options (explicit):
- Option A — Accelerated: Contract sign by 2027-05-14; Provisioning 2027-05-24; Pilot start 2027-06-01; Close 2027-06-30
- Option B — Baseline: Contract sign by 2027-05-31; Provisioning 2027-06-15; Pilot start 2027-06-21; Close 2027-07-21
- Option C — Conservative: Contract sign by 2027-06-15; Provisioning 2027-07-01; Pilot start 2027-07-15; Close 2027-08-15

Risks / gates to flag proactively:
- Risk: KMS integration could add 2–3 weeks if compliance needs HSM procurement (Mitigation: start KMS questionnaire with Aditya now).
- Risk: Sample data refresh cadence might delay eval (Mitigation: set weekly ingest window; Redwood to provide a small synthetic fallback set).

Action items (please confirm who):
1) Procurement at Borealis to confirm SOC2 evidence request list and provide target sign date (Emily / procurement).
2) Borealis infra to confirm SFTP endpoint and add firewall rules (Ravi).
3) Redwood (Marissa) to schedule a pilot kickoff tech session the week of 6/21 (if Option B chosen).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_MAP_kickoff_Borealis (redwood_map_v1.1.xlsx uploaded)
HubSpot: HS-9876543

I'll wait for procurement's ask and your preferred timeline option. If Option A is required, we'll prioritize legal and infra lanes this week.

—Logan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood_map_v1.1.xlsx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily@borealishealth.com>, Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@borealishealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 09:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: proposed role split, milestones, and risk gates

Thanks everyone — quick alignment note from Redwood CS side.
- We're aligned on F1 >= 0.72 for the pilot acceptance gate. I'll build the evaluation rubric into the MAP sheet and add row-level owners for model evaluation tasks.
- Proposed micro-schedule for pilot validation week (if Option B):
   Mon 06/21 — onboarding + data ingest smoke tests (owner: Borealis data ops)
   Tue 06/22 — inference runs + latency profiling (owner: Redwood integration)
   Wed 06/23 — annotated samples and metrics (owner: Borealis clinical ops)
   Thu 06/24 — bug triage + fix window (owner: joint)
   Fri 06/25 — final metrics review & sign-off (owner: Borealis clinical ops)

Next asks: please confirm by EOD Mon 04/26 which timeline option you prefer and who on your team will be the formal procurement POC (name + email). Once confirmed, Aditya will prepare the initial security packet and cost estimate for procurement review.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

(Attachment: map_kickoff_slide.pdf)
